info.description: Opening full-screen section: the scroll-driven pen animation, the headline, and the order button.

headline_line1.description: First line of the headline, for example "Smart pen".

headline_line2.description: Second line of the headline, for example "for real thinking".

lottie_url.description: Web address of the pen animation file (.json). Upload the file in Media Library, then paste its URL here.

mobile_fallback.description: Still image shown instead of the animation on phones, where the animation is too heavy to download.

mobile_fallback_alt.description: Describes the fallback image for screen readers and when the image fails to load.

order_label.description: Text on the order button, before the product name.

product_name.description: Product name shown on the order button.

price.description: Price shown on the order button. Free text so the currency symbol can be changed.
